name: Night Wizard Mahou Taisen ~The Peace Plan to Save the World~
original_name: ナイトウィザード　魔法大戦～The Peace Plan to Save the World～
source:
Peaceful school life is interrupted by a transfer student arrival. Newcomer vows to kill main character who has his abilities awakened shortly afterwards. With the power of science and magic protagonist needs to defeat demons and save the world in card battles.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-june-2004-3days-michiteyuku.html]vndbreview[/url]]

An Adult PC game set in the "Night Wizard!" universe.
